replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
Promoters were first binned based on their log2 Pol II ChIP-seq signal. Within each bin, the median frequency of each of the promoter state was calculated.
outputs.explanation: The panel shows median state frequencies computed across a defined population of promoters, and the caption explicitly reports n = 5912 promoters, giving both the number and type of units underlying the plotted data.

replicate_statements: Single-locus example showing single-molecule sorting of a highly active, TATA-box containing Drosophila promoter (Svil, 94th percentile by Pol II ChIP-seq).
outputs.explanation: The panel displays quantified state frequencies (percentages) derived from single DNA molecules at one locus, and the number of molecules (2952) is directly stated on the panel, satisfying replicate number and type reporting.

replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in mouse promoters (n = 6122 promoters).
outputs.explanation: Analogous to panel A, the caption explicitly reports n = 6122 promoters as the basis for the median state frequency distributions shown.

replicate_statements: Single-locus example of a single-molecule sorting of a highly active, TATA-box containing mouse promoter (Skp1, 97th percentile by Pol II ChIP-seq). Same representation as (B).
outputs.explanation: As in panel B, the panel reports the number of single DNA molecules (2871) underlying the quantified state percentages shown.

replicate_statements: Comparison of PIC state frequency between mouse (TATA-less n = 572 promoters; TATA-containing n = 64 promoters) and Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters) promoters.
The statistical comparisons between groups were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
outputs.explanation: Boxplots compare groups with statistical testing, and the caption reports n for each of the four groups (mouse and Drosophila, TATA-less and TATA-containing promoters), with type explicitly given as promoters; the lowest n (64) is well above the minimum threshold for summary statistics.

replicate_statements: Comparison of Pol II state frequency between mouse (TATA-less n = 572 promoters; TATA-containing n = 64 promoters) and Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters) promoters.
The statistical comparisons between groups were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
outputs.explanation: Same as panel E: boxplots with statistical comparisons report n and type (promoters) for all four groups, with the lowest n (64) sufficient for summary statistics.
